predict_next_obs_mse_method: teacher-forced posterior context along each held-out test episode, then one RSSM prior step with the dataset action, decoded by the trained decoder (upstream imagine+decode, single stochastic sample). Trained ONLINE in CartPole; test_* never used for training.
policy_note: upstream stochastic policy (sampled), CartPole-v1 seeds 1000-1009, cap 500 steps
notes: Actual upstream code executed (embodied.run.train + dreamerv3.agent.Agent subclass for eval hooks only; upstream tree unmodified). Short training (a few thousand env steps) so numbers reflect an under-trained smallest-size model. Capabilities: predict/simulate (latent imagination) are native; DreamerV3 has no model sharing/merging or multi-agent shared world protocol (single-agent, per-run checkpoint). Wall time (823.8s) was measured while MuZero training and a smoke run shared the 4 cores, plus another agent, so it is inflated. train_steps = env steps (5000) at train_ratio 256 (~1250 gradient updates). Next-obs MSE beats the identity baseline on test_* (0.0255 vs 0.0311) but on train_* transitions it does not (0.0372); single seed, single stochastic sample, so treat as indicative not conclusive.
